items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Never know a trumpet player by the name of Ned. I don't know if his last name or first name.

ctx.x: Babu, I think he called him. He's a old town. I think he was grown when Piku was little.

Yeah. Never know a trumpet player by the name of Ned. I don't know if his last name or first name. Ned, they called him. No. I might know him by her name, you know. I heard that. I heard that. Because you see, all of them had different, they had nicknames. Like we give Wooden Joe, Wooden Joe. He's not Wooden Joe, he's named Joe Nicholas. That's his name, Joe Nicholas. Why'd you call him Wooden Joe? And we called him Wooden Joe, because he played so hard. He never wanted it. When he'd blow that horn, man, he'd…
Good blues trumpet player. Yeah, he was good.
